metadata.description: Existing central Log Analytics workspace. This template does not change ingestion or workspace billing.
SQL VM resource ID used to scope all content to this scenario.
Enable scheduled detections. Sentinel must already be onboarded on the workspace.
Minimum SQL Server Audit failed logins in a 15-minute window from one client against one account.

input.filter:
[format('| where TimeGenerated > ago(1h) and IngestedAt > ago(5m)
| where EventID == 33205 and SimulationTheme == ''{0}''
', variables('simulationDetections')[copyIndex('simulationRuleDetections')].theme)]

variables.$fxv#0:
Event
| where _ResourceId =~ VmResourceId
| where EventLog == "Application" and (Source =~ "MSSQLSERVER" or Source startswith "MSSQL$")
| where EventID in (33205, 18453, 18454, 18456)
| extend IngestedAt = ingestion_time()
| extend ActionId = extract(@"(?:^|\s)action_id:\s*(\S+)", 1, RenderedDescription),
    AuditTime = todatetime(extract(@"(?:^|\s)event_time:([\s\S]*?)\s+sequence_number:", 1, RenderedDescription)),
    Actor = trim(@"\s+", extract(@"(?:^|\s)server_principal_name:([\s\S]*?)\s+server_principal_sid:", 1, RenderedDescription)),
    TargetLogin = trim(@"\s+", extract(@"(?:^|\s)target_server_principal_name:([\s\S]*?)\s+target_server_principal_sid:", 1, RenderedDescription)),
    TargetSid = extract(@"(?:^|\s)target_server_principal_sid:([^\s]*)", 1, RenderedDescription),
    ActorSid = extract(@"(?:^|\s)server_principal_sid:([^\s]*)", 1, RenderedDescription),
    ClientAddress = trim(@"\s+", extract(@"(?:^|\s)client_ip:([\s\S]*?)\s+permission_bitmask:", 1, RenderedDescription)),
    ApplicationName = trim(@"\s+", extract(@"(?:^|\s)application_name:([\s\S]*?)\s+connection_id:", 1, RenderedDescription)),
    Statement = trim(@"\s+", extract(@"(?:^|\s)statement:([\s\S]*?)\s+additional_information:", 1, RenderedDescription)),
    ObjectName = trim(@"\s+", extract(@"(?:^|\s)object_name:([\s\S]*?)\s+statement:", 1, RenderedDescription)),
    SimulationTheme = extract(@"dojo-simulation-sample:([a-z-]+):", 1, RenderedDescription),
    SimulationRunId = extract(@"dojo-simulation-sample:[a-z-]+:([0-9a-f-]{36})", 1, RenderedDescription),
    Succeeded = tobool(extract(@"(?:^|\s)succeeded:(true|false)", 1, RenderedDescription)),
    SequenceGroup = extract(@"(?:^|\s)sequence_group_id:([^\s]*)", 1, RenderedDescription),
    SequenceNumber = toint(extract(@"(?:^|\s)sequence_number:(\d+)", 1, RenderedDescription))
| extend Actor = iff(EventID == 33205, Actor, extract(@"user '([^']*)'", 1, RenderedDescription)),
    ClientAddress = iff(EventID == 33205, ClientAddress, extract(@"\[CLIENT: ([^\]]+)\]", 1, RenderedDescription)),
    Succeeded = case(EventID in (18453, 18454), true, EventID == 18456, false, Succeeded)
| extend Operation = case(
    ActionId == "LGEA", "Login enabled",
    ActionId == "LGDA", "Login disabled",
    ActionId == "PWR", "Login password changed",
    ActionId == "AUSC", "Audit configuration changed",
    Statement matches regex @"(?i)^ALTER\s+LOGIN\s+(?:\[(?:[^\]]|\]\])+\]|\S+)\s+ENABLE\b", "Login enabled",
    Statement matches regex @"(?i)^ALTER\s+LOGIN\s+(?:\[(?:[^\]]|\]\])+\]|\S+)\s+DISABLE\b", "Login disabled",
    Statement matches regex @"(?i)^ALTER\s+LOGIN\s+.*?\s+WITH\s+PASSWORD\b", "Login password changed",
    Statement matches regex @"(?i)^ALTER\s+LOGIN\s+.*?\s+WITH\s+NAME\b", "Login renamed",
    Statement matches regex @"(?i)^(CREATE|ALTER|DROP)\s+(SERVER|DATABASE)\s+AUDIT\b", "Audit configuration changed",
    ActionId == "LGIS" or EventID in (18453, 18454), "Login succeeded",
    ActionId == "LGIF" or EventID == 18456, "Login failed",
    "Other SQL audit")
| extend TargetLogin = iff(isempty(TargetLogin) and Operation in ("Login enabled", "Login disabled", "Login password changed", "Login renamed"), ObjectName, TargetLogin)
| extend IsBuiltInAdmin = TargetSid in~ ("01", "0x01") or (isempty(TargetSid) and TargetLogin =~ "sa"),
    IsBuiltInAdminActor = ActorSid in~ ("01", "0x01") or (isempty(ActorSid) and Actor =~ "sa"),
    Outcome = case(Succeeded == true, "Succeeded", Succeeded == false, "Failed", "Unknown"),
    EventKey = hash_sha256(strcat(_ResourceId, "|", Source, "|", tostring(EventID), "|", RenderedDescription, "|", tostring(TimeGenerated)))
| summarize arg_max(IngestedAt, *) by EventKey
| project TimeGenerated, AuditTime, IngestedAt, Computer, Source, EventID, ActionId, Operation,
    Actor, TargetLogin, IsBuiltInAdmin, IsBuiltInAdminActor, ClientAddress, ApplicationName,
    SimulationTheme, SimulationRunId, Succeeded, Outcome, SequenceGroup, SequenceNumber, EventKey, _ResourceId

simulationDetections.displayName: Dojo SQL - safe brute force simulation evidence
simulationDetections.description: A portal-triggered, read-only SQL Audit sample marked as the brute force training theme. This is a Sentinel training incident, not a Defender for Cloud alert and does not perform authentication attacks.

simulationDetections.displayName: Dojo SQL - safe suspicious application simulation evidence
simulationDetections.description: A portal-triggered SQL Audit sample marked as the suspicious application training theme. This is a Sentinel training incident, not a Defender for Cloud alert and does not run harmful software.

simulationDetections.displayName: Dojo SQL - safe SQL injection simulation evidence
simulationDetections.description: A portal-triggered parameterized SQL Audit sample marked as the SQL injection training theme. This is a Sentinel training incident, not a Defender for Cloud alert and does not exploit injection.

simulationDetections.displayName: Dojo SQL - safe principal anomaly simulation evidence
simulationDetections.description: A portal-triggered SQL Audit sample marked as the principal anomaly training theme. This is a Sentinel training incident, not a Defender for Cloud alert and does not alter principals.

simulationDetections.displayName: Dojo SQL - safe external source simulation evidence
simulationDetections.description: A portal-triggered SQL Audit sample marked as the external source training theme. This is a Sentinel training incident, not a Defender for Cloud alert and does not access external sources.

simulationDetections.displayName: Dojo SQL - safe obfuscated shell simulation evidence
simulationDetections.description: A portal-triggered SQL Audit sample marked as the obfuscated shell training theme. This is a Sentinel training incident, not a Defender for Cloud alert and does not run shell or encoded commands.

staticDetections.displayName: Dojo SQL - login enabled, disabled, renamed or password changed
staticDetections.description: SQL Server Audit login changes, including the renamed built-in administrator. Includes failed attempts; inspect Outcome. Legitimate portal operations and bootstrap also trigger this training detection.
staticDetections.filter:
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1h) and IngestedAt > ago(5m)
| where EventID == 33205
| where Operation in ('Login enabled', 'Login disabled', 'Login password changed', 'Login renamed')

staticDetections.displayName: Dojo SQL - built-in administrator login succeeded
staticDetections.description: Successful SQL Server Audit authentication by the built-in administrator SID, including renamed accounts. Name fallback only applies when the SID is absent.
staticDetections.filter:
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1h) and IngestedAt > ago(5m)
| where EventID == 33205 and Operation == 'Login succeeded' and Succeeded == true
| where IsBuiltInAdminActor

staticDetections.description: Repeated failed SQL Server Audit authentications per VM, principal and client over 15 minutes. Uses 33205 only to avoid counting the same attempt again as instance event 18456. Retriggers while a burst continues.
staticDetections.filter:
[replace('| where TimeGenerated > ago(15m)
| where EventID == 33205 and Operation == ''Login failed''
| summarize Attempts = count(), FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated), TimeGenerated = max(TimeGenerated), LastIngested = max(IngestedAt) by Computer, Actor, ClientAddress, _ResourceId
  | where Attempts >= FAILED_LOGIN_THRESHOLD and LastIngested > ago(5m)
| extend Operation = ''Repeated failed logins'', Outcome = ''Failed'', TargetLogin = Actor, ActionId = ''LGIF'', EventID = 33205
  ', 'FAILED_LOGIN_THRESHOLD', string(parameters('failedLoginThreshold')))]

staticDetections.description: SQL audit creation, alteration or removal. Review authorized bootstrap changes before escalating; ingestion silence is not proof that auditing remains enabled.
staticDetections.filter:
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1h) and IngestedAt > ago(5m)
| where EventID == 33205 and Operation == 'Audit configuration changed'

variables.huntFilter:
| where TimeGenerated > ago(24h)
| where Operation in ('Login enabled', 'Login disabled', 'Login password changed', 'Login renamed', 'Audit configuration changed')
| order by TimeGenerated desc
variables.healthFilter:
| where TimeGenerated > ago(24h)
| summarize Events = count(), LastEvent = max(TimeGenerated), LastIngested = max(IngestedAt) by Computer, EventID, ActionId, Operation
| order by LastEvent desc

properties.alertDetailsOverride: [if(equals(variables('detections')[copyIndex()].key, 'login-changes'), createObject('alertDisplayNameFormat', 'Dojo SQL - {{Operation}}: {{TargetLogin}} ({{Outcome}})', 'alertDescriptionFormat', 'SQL login change on {{Computer}} by {{Actor}}. Built-in administrator target: {{IsBuiltInAdmin}}. Review the outcome; failed attempts do not confirm a state change.'), null())]
